title: Module structures for the finite constant completion tower
statement: theorem finiteSystem_module_instances (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) : Nonempty (∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Cᵒᵖ), Module (A ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)) (adicTerm J A (finiteSystemUnder J A I) n U))

proof.text: Evaluate each finite constant coefficient sheaf sectionwise and equip it with the induced module structure over its quotient coefficient ring.
